TABLE claimed_items.Create Table:
CREATE TABLE `claimed_items` (
  `claimed_item_id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `claimed_item_code` varchar(15) DEFAULT NULL,
  `item_code` varchar(15) NOT NULL,
  `claimer_first_name` varchar(50) NOT NULL,
  `claimer_middle_name` varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL,
  `claimer_last_name` varchar(50) NOT NULL,
  `contact_number` varchar(20) NOT NULL,
  `claimant_email` varchar(254) NOT NULL,
  `claimant_affiliation` enum('Student','Faculty','Staff','Visitor') NOT NULL,
  `last_seen_location` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `last_seen_date_time` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `item_description` text NOT NULL,
  `identifying_features` text NOT NULL,
  `contents` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `additional_evidence` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `evidence_file_path` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `status` enum('Pending','Under Review','Approved','Rejected','Returned') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Pending',
  `staff_notes` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `date_claimed` datetime DEFAULT current_timestamp(),
  `date_updated` datetime DEFAULT current_timestamp() ON UPDATE current_timestamp(),
  `active_item_code` varchar(15) GENERATED ALWAYS AS (case when `status` in ('Pending','Under Review','Approved','Returned') then `item_code` else NULL end) STORED,
  PRIMARY KEY (`claimed_item_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `claimed_item_code` (`claimed_item_code`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_claim_active_item` (`active_item_code`),
  KEY `idx_claim_item_history` (`item_code`,`claimed_item_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `claimed_items_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`item_code`) REFERENCES `items` (`item_code`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=13 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_general_ci

TABLE items.Create Table:
CREATE TABLE `items` (
  `item_id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `item_code` varchar(15) DEFAULT NULL,
  `NAME` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `DESCRIPTION` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `item_type` enum('lost','found') NOT NULL,
  `STATUS` enum('open','resolved','closed') DEFAULT 'open',
  `category_code` varchar(15) DEFAULT NULL,
  `branch_code` varchar(15) DEFAULT NULL,
  `location_code` varchar(15) DEFAULT NULL,
  `item_file_path` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `public_color` varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL,
  `date_found` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `date_reported` datetime DEFAULT current_timestamp(),
  `close_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `times_unclaimed` int(11) DEFAULT 0,
  PRIMARY KEY (`item_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `item_code` (`item_code`),
  KEY `category_code` (`category_code`),
  KEY `branch_code` (`branch_code`),
  KEY `location_code` (`location_code`),
  CONSTRAINT `items_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`category_code`) REFERENCES `categories` (`category_code`) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  CONSTRAINT `items_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`branch_code`) REFERENCES `branches` (`branch_code`) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  CONSTRAINT `items_ibfk_3` FOREIGN KEY (`location_code`) REFERENCES `locations` (`location_code`) ON DELETE SET NULL
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=230 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_general_ci

VIEW vw_openAllItems.Create View: CREATE ALGORITHM=UNDEFINED DEFINER=`gapangita_user`@`localhost` SQL SECURITY DEFINER VIEW `vw_openallitems` AS select `i`.`item_id` AS `item_id`,`i`.`item_code` AS `item_code`,`i`.`item_type` AS `item_type`,case when `cl`.`status` in ('Pending','Under Review') then 'Under Verification' else 'Available' end AS `status`,`i`.`category_code` AS `category_code`,`c`.`NAME` AS `categoryName`,`i`.`public_color` AS `public_color`,`i`.`branch_code` AS `branch_code`,`b`.`NAME` AS `branchName`,`i`.`location_code` AS `location_code`,cast(`i`.`date_found` as date) AS `date_found`,`i`.`date_reported` AS `date_reported` from (((`items` `i` left join `categories` `c` on(`c`.`category_code` = `i`.`category_code`)) left join `branches` `b` on(`b`.`branch_code` = `i`.`branch_code`)) left join `claimed_items` `cl` on(`cl`.`active_item_code` = `i`.`item_code`)) where `i`.`STATUS` = 'open' and coalesce(`i`.`close_at`,`i`.`date_reported` + interval 21 day) > current_timestamp() and (`cl`.`status` is null or `cl`.`status` in ('Pending','Under Review'))

PROCEDURE sp_insert_into_claimed_items.Create Procedure:
CREATE DEFINER=`gapangita_user`@`localhost` PROCEDURE `sp_insert_into_claimed_items`(
    IN p_item_code VARCHAR(15),
    IN p_claimer_first_name VARCHAR(50),
    IN p_claimer_middle_name VARCHAR(50),
    IN p_claimer_last_name VARCHAR(50),
    IN p_contact_number VARCHAR(20),
    IN p_claimant_email VARCHAR(254),
    IN p_claimant_affiliation ENUM('Student', 'Faculty', 'Staff', 'Visitor'),
    IN p_last_seen_location VARCHAR(255),
    IN p_last_seen_date_time DATETIME,
    IN p_item_description TEXT,
    IN p_identifying_features TEXT,
    IN p_contents TEXT,
    IN p_additional_evidence TEXT,
    IN p_evidence_file_path VARCHAR(255)
)
BEGIN
    DECLARE v_item_status VARCHAR(15) DEFAULT NULL;
    DECLARE v_deadline DATETIME;
    DECLARE v_active INT DEFAULT 0;
    SELECT STATUS, COALESCE(close_at, DATE_ADD(date_reported, INTERVAL 21 DAY))
      INTO v_item_status, v_deadline FROM items WHERE item_code=p_item_code FOR UPDATE;
    IF v_item_status IS NULL THEN
        SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MYSQL_ERRNO=30002, MESSAGE_TEXT='The selected item does not exist.';
    END IF;
    SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_active FROM claimed_items WHERE active_item_code=p_item_code;
    IF v_active > 0 THEN
        SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MYSQL_ERRNO=30001, MESSAGE_TEXT='An active claim already exists for this item.';
    END IF;
    IF v_item_status <> 'open' OR v_deadline <= NOW() THEN
        SIGNAL SQLSTATE '45000' SET MYSQL_ERRNO=30003, MESSAGE_TEXT='The selected item is no longer available for claiming.';
    END IF;
    INSERT INTO claimed_items (
        item_code,
        claimer_first_name,
        claimer_middle_name,
        claimer_last_name,
        contact_number,
        claimant_email,
        claimant_affiliation,
        last_seen_location,
        last_seen_date_time,
        item_description,
        identifying_features,
        contents,
        additional_evidence,
        evidence_file_path,
        status
    ) VALUES (
        p_item_code,
        p_claimer_first_name,
        p_claimer_middle_name,
        p_claimer_last_name,
        p_contact_number,
        p_claimant_email,
        p_claimant_affiliation,
        p_last_seen_location,
        p_last_seen_date_time,
        p_item_description,
        p_identifying_features,
        p_contents,
        p_additional_evidence,
        p_evidence_file_path,
        'Pending'
    );
END

TRIGGER trg_reset_close_date.SQL Original Statement:
CREATE DEFINER=`gapangita_user`@`localhost` TRIGGER trg_reset_close_date BEFORE UPDATE ON items FOR EACH ROW
BEGIN
    -- Rejection must never restart the original listing period.
    IF NEW.status='open' AND NEW.close_at IS NULL THEN
        SET NEW.close_at=DATE_ADD(NEW.date_reported, INTERVAL 21 DAY);
    END IF;
END

PROCEDURE sp_expire_items.Create Procedure:
CREATE DEFINER=`gapangita_user`@`localhost` PROCEDURE `sp_expire_items`()
BEGIN
    UPDATE items SET STATUS='closed'
    WHERE STATUS='open' AND COALESCE(close_at, DATE_ADD(date_reported, INTERVAL 21 DAY)) <= NOW();
END
